title: The systems a journey step can call
description: One entry per system. Journeys name a system by its name, and the check on a pull request makes sure every name they use is here.

name.title: Name
name.description: What a journey file writes under systems, and what the lane shows, such as GAR.

short.title: Short name
short.description: Shown in the lane instead of the name, for a long name, such as Instruments for Payment Instruments.

full.title: Full name
full.description: Shown when you hover over the call: the system's full name and what it does.
